Calculate relative peptide percentages

Source: R/functions.R
percentage_calculation.Rd

Merges MS1 and sample tables, keeps light peptides, computes within-protein relative abundances, and optionally filters unmodified peptides, peptide selections, and sample selections.

Usage

percentage_calculation(
  ms1,
  sample,
  exclude_un = TRUE,
  selected_peptides = NULL,
  selected_samples = NULL,
  max_percentage = 100
)

Arguments

ms1

A data frame containing peptide-level MS1 measurements.

sample

A data frame containing sample metadata.

exclude_un

Logical; if TRUE, exclude peptide names ending in "un" or "unun".

selected_peptides

Optional character vector of peptide names to keep.

selected_samples

Optional character vector of sample names to keep.

max_percentage

Numeric upper bound used to filter implausible percentage values.

Value

A processed data frame with merged metadata and a Percentage column.
